scientific_question: Does the exact one-step operator-balance margin organize the long-horizon route difference by showing when direct eco-genetic feedback extends positive-margin refugia, especially in the reversed configuration, and does an all-negative margin state discriminate later functional loss on the full denominator?

theorem.exact_sign_claim: sign(M) equals sign(q_next-0.625) for every patch-generation under the corresponding condition

replication.paired_seed_mapping: same trajectory seed for all four conditions within every master-seed/replicate key
replication.seed_reuse: no master seed is reused from the earlier 202801-202805, pathway-edge, or 6,000-pair focused proof ensembles

primary_estimands.exact_transition_audit: Across all patch-generations, margin sign must exactly match q_next side of 0.625; any mismatch invalidates the run.
primary_estimands.positive_margin_refuge_generations: For each trajectory, count generations 1..40 in which at least one patch has nonnegative operator-balance margin before the q update.
primary_estimands.direct_feedback_extension: Within assignment, full-feedback positive-margin refuge-generations minus q-only positive-margin refuge-generations on paired keys.
primary_estimands.primary_DID: RR direct-feedback extension minus AA direct-feedback extension. A paired 95% CI strictly above zero resolves preferential RR route repair; an interval containing zero is unresolved; a CI strictly below zero resolves the opposite direction.
primary_estimands.full_denominator_marker: Within AA_full and RR_full separately and pooled, marker = all four full-feedback margins are negative at generation 20; target = realised all-patch high-trait loss by generation 40. Report sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV, FPR and binary-marker AUC. No minimum performance is required.

secondary_estimands.repair_wedge_patch_generations: Within each full-feedback trajectory state, count patch-generations with q-only counterfactual margin < 0 <= full margin.
secondary_estimands.suppression_wedge_patch_generations: Count patch-generations with full margin < 0 <= q-only counterfactual margin.
secondary_estimands.first_all_negative_margin_generation: First generation at which all four margins are negative, censored after generation 40.
secondary_estimands.marker_to_loss_lead: Among generation-40 losses, report how often the all-negative margin event occurs before realised all-patch loss; do not infer discrimination without the non-event denominator.

decision_rules.route_repair_resolved: primary DID 95% CI strictly above zero
decision_rules.route_repair_opposite: primary DID 95% CI strictly below zero
decision_rules.marker_validity: Report metrics exactly as observed. Precedence without specificity is not predictive validity.

stop_rules: No new seeds, horizons, margin thresholds, endpoint definitions, assignments, barrier schedules or feedback weights may be added after the first outcome file is opened.
Do not tune the generation-20 marker after seeing specificity or AUC.
Do not convert the exact one-step margin theorem into a claim of long-horizon sufficiency unless the separately locked finite evidence supports that stronger statement.
Natural examples are not part of this validation and remain Discussion-only ecological projections.
